name: The Queenbreaker

frame.name: Wire Rifle
frame.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap between scopes and alter this weapon's firing behavior. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

perks.name: Marksman Sights
perks.description: Long-range sights with slower charge time and greater damage. Fires a single bolt that chains to nearby targets and blinds them on hit. Displays ammo and charge levels. Select this scope to spawn with it equipped by default.

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.description:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

flavor: Despite the Breakers' treachery, Her Majesty still stands.

catalyst.name: The Queenbreaker Catalyst
catalyst.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
